dataSource: items.ocp (OMNICELL-CONTENT v3, client 18.8.50_EP1) via tools/mp-weapon-extractor/Program.cs; every id/name verified against itemnames.sql at extraction time

definition.pool: Items whose ToWield carries a weapon-skill requirement, that are NOT profession-locked to a profession other than Shade, whose primary wield skill is one of [Piercing, MartialArts, MeleeEnergy], and that are placed in a HAND slot (Stat.Slot bit for EquipSlot.Weap_RightHand or Weap_LeftHand).
definition.handSlotRule: The hand-slot test is what separates weapons from items that merely carry a weapon-skill ToWield requirement. Without it the Legacy of the Xan '[skill] Skill NCU (n/6)' chips (Deck slots 1-6, no attack table, zero damage) are emitted as weapons - that was the bug in the previous generator, and their LoX expansion bit then mislabelled them as Xan weapons.
definition.endgameTiers: TL7 = ToWield TitleLevel >= 7 (level 205+). TL6 = ToWield TitleLevel = 6 (level 190+). expansion = no TitleLevel gate but top QL >= 200, max damage >= 300 and an Expansion(389) gate. high-rk = the same QL/damage floor with no expansion gate.
definition.endgameThresholdIsAJudgement: TitleLevel is read straight from the item and is authoritative. The 'QL >= 200 AND max damage >= 300' floor for the lower two tiers is a THRESHOLD CHOSEN FOR THIS FILE, not a fact from the data: QL alone does not separate endgame gear from ordinary shop weapons, which also span QL 1-200. Tune it here if you disagree.
definition.dedup: One row per MODEL (grouped by name). qlRange gives the model's span in items.ocp; every requirement, damage and gate figure is read at the model's TOP QL (statsReadAtQl) because those scale with QL.
definition.lineClassification: By item NAME against verified name sets (Xan / Beast / Ofab / Kyr'Ozch / Perennium / Dreadloch / other). Deliberately NOT by expansion bit - the expansion bit means 'you need this expansion to wield it', not 'this is that expansion's weapon line', and using it as a line classifier is what produced the bad Xan labels before.
definition.exclusions: NPC/monster-only templates (name matches '- Monster', 'monster only', 'Monster Version'), templates with no row in itemnames.sql, and GM/test/vehicle templates caught by four measured filters: a QL range topping out above 300 (no player item in AO exceeds QL 300, so these are monster/innate weapon templates); max damage >= 1000 (no verified player weapon line in this data exceeds 750, and the best ordinary shop weapons ~950); primary wield requirement > 2600 (the highest legitimate requirement in the file is 2500, Gan'Kar Rifle QL300); and QL >= 200 with a primary requirement under 100 (a QL300 template whose requirement never scaled). All are listed with their reason in _unverified.excludedModels.

sourceCoverage.note: 'Specific' means the row carries a cited acquisition (mob/playfield/tradeskill steps). 'unknown' rows say so in their source text; no drop location is approximated. 13 of the 120 unknown rows were filled in by a dedicated Shade acquisition pass (see _shadeAcquisitionOverlay); the rest stay unknown on purpose.

weapons.name: Corrupted Lord of Deceit
weapons.source: Pyramid of Home / "Dark Pyramid Below" (6-man, level 201-220). A DIRECT DROP - not a tradeskill step above 'X of the Xan'. The Corrupted weapons are a parallel endgame drop line, added in patch 18.8.6 (27 Oct 2015). They drop from the bosses of Pyramid of Home, a 6-man level 201-220 dungeon: Cybernetic Daemon, Azdaja the Joyous, Maiden, then Phobettor. Portals last 4 hours (18.8.7). Entrance: the giant crater north of the city of Home on Rubi-Ka; since 18.8.6 you enter through the large door behind Number Nine inside the Temple of Home, Broken Shores. Access needs ONE of: any Profession Nanodeck worn (Dust Brigade quest base version or the Xan-upgraded one), the quest 'Guarding the Source' completed, or the Legacy of the Xan quests completed. The guide reports it also worked with just a Beast profession star worn. Patch 18.8.8 (9 Nov 2015) confirms what these are: the duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry was renamed and modified into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, and the Achaean Conqueror was added to drop alongside the other Corrupted weapons. That is why the client data shows them as QL 300 Legacy-of-the-Xan-gated weapons with the same flavour text as the 'X of the Xan' items but different damage and a title level 7 (level 205+) gate instead of title level 6. The Wisdom versions come in Atrox and non-Atrox and right/left-hand variants, adjusted with a screwdriver to match breed. No per-boss drop rates are published. NOTE: A claim that Corrupted weapons can be fed to a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device circulates online but traces only to a source outside the allowed list, and the 18.8.8 rename note argues against it. NOT recorded as fact.

weapons.name: Ofab Viper Mk 6
weapons.source: Battlestation - Ofab terminals, Unicorn Defence Hub. Bought as Mk 1 with Victory Points at the Ofab weapon terminals in the Unicorn Defence Hub (the 'Ofab Shop') in the Battle Station central area. VP is earned on Battlestations and on Lost Eden (Alien Mothership) missions. Terminals are bracketed by level: 10-30, 31-60, 61-100, 101-150, 151-200, 201-214, 215-220. Upgraded Mk 1 -> Mk 6 (five upgrades, strictly sequential) by adding a Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material clump to the weapon. No tradeskill skill is required; the clump must be at least 80% of the weapon's QL. Each upgrade also changes the weapon's appearance. Bio-Material by weapon: Type 34 for Ofab Panther (1h Blunt) and Ofab Bear (2h Blunt); Type 18 for Ofab Mongoose (1h Edged), Ofab Wolf (2h Edged) and Ofab Viper (Piercing); Type 812 for Ofab Peregrine (Pistol), Ofab Hawk (SMG) and Ofab Tiger (Bow); Type 687 for Ofab Cobra (Rifle), Ofab Shark (Assault Rifle) and Ofab Silverback (Shotgun). The clumps drop from the bosses in Lost Eden Alien Mothership missions (taken from the Unicorn Recruiter at the Unicorn Outpost in the Outerzones, via ICC) and from the Dreadloch bosses at the Clan and Omni camps. No VP price list is published; the only figure found is a player report of 1100 VP for a QL75 Ofab Pistol. NOTE: ao-universe lists Type 812 as covering Bow; wiki.aodb.us lists it as Crossbow. Unresolved - both recorded in _unverified.

weapons.name: Kyr'Ozch Energy Rapier - Type 992
weapons.source: Alien city raids / Alien Mothership (base weapon + clump). Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type [n] + untyped Kyr'Ozch weapon = the typed weapon. The type decides which special attacks the weapon gets. Make the typed clump first: Kyr'Ozch Structural Analyzer + Solid Clump of Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material = Kyr'Ozch Bio-Material - Type [n]. Typing needs 6x the weapon's QL in Mechanical Engineering and 6x QL in Weapon Smithing, and the clump must be at least 90% of the weapon's QL. Typing is PERMANENT - a weapon cannot be re-typed or cleared. Solid Clumps and the untyped weapons drop from the alien city-raid boss (the General) and from the boss on the alien Mothership. Alien City Raid needs the AI expansion, an org city and a fully charged city controller with a CRU; documented raid bosses are Ankari, Cha, Illari, Jaxx, Rimah and Xoch. No drop rates are published. weapons.name: Corrupted Lady of Wisdom
weapons.source: Pyramid of Home / "Dark Pyramid Below" (6-man, level 201-220). A DIRECT DROP - not a tradeskill step above 'X of the Xan'. The Corrupted weapons are a parallel endgame drop line, added in patch 18.8.6 (27 Oct 2015). They drop from the bosses of Pyramid of Home, a 6-man level 201-220 dungeon: Cybernetic Daemon, Azdaja the Joyous, Maiden, then Phobettor. Portals last 4 hours (18.8.7). Entrance: the giant crater north of the city of Home on Rubi-Ka; since 18.8.6 you enter through the large door behind Number Nine inside the Temple of Home, Broken Shores. Access needs ONE of: any Profession Nanodeck worn (Dust Brigade quest base version or the Xan-upgraded one), the quest 'Guarding the Source' completed, or the Legacy of the Xan quests completed. The guide reports it also worked with just a Beast profession star worn. Patch 18.8.8 (9 Nov 2015) confirms what these are: the duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry was renamed and modified into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, and the Achaean Conqueror was added to drop alongside the other Corrupted weapons. That is why the client data shows them as QL 300 Legacy-of-the-Xan-gated weapons with the same flavour text as the 'X of the Xan' items but different damage and a title level 7 (level 205+) gate instead of title level 6. The Wisdom versions come in Atrox and non-Atrox and right/left-hand variants, adjusted with a screwdriver to match breed. No per-boss drop rates are published. NOTE: A claim that Corrupted weapons can be fed to a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device circulates online but traces only to a source outside the allowed list, and the 18.8.8 rename note argues against it. NOT recorded as fact.

criteria.summary: Picks are computed from the items' OWN stats in items.ocp plus this profession's skill cost factors. They are NOT a community tier list and are not presented as one.
criteria.dpsProxy: avgDamage / (attackDelaySec + rechargeDelaySec), where avgDamage = (MinDamage+MaxDamage)/2 and the two delays are the item's AttackDelay (stat 294) and RechargeDelay (stat 210) in 1/100 s. This is a COMPARISON PROXY ONLY: it ignores initiative caps, crit rate, add-damage, damage modifiers, nano buffs and special attacks, so it ranks these weapons against each other on the item data - it is not in-game DPS.
criteria.ipWeightedReq: Sum over every ToWield skill and special-attack requirement of (requiredValue x this profession's cost factor for that skill, from reference/skillcaps.json). Lower means cheaper for this profession to actually reach. It is a relative IP-burden number, not an IP total.
criteria.topDamage: The model with the highest dpsProxy in the skill. Reported with its gates (expansion, title level) so an unreachable pick is obvious.
criteria.bestValue: Among models that still reach at least 60% of that skill's top dpsProxy - i.e. among weapons that are actually competitive - the one with the highest dpsProxy / ipWeightedReq. The 60% floor is there because without it the metric just picks the weakest, cheapest weapon in the skill; it is a stated threshold, not a fact.
criteria.bestWithoutExpansion: The highest dpsProxy model whose ToWield carries NO Expansion(389) gate - i.e. the best option for a character without the expansions. Null if every endgame model in that skill is expansion-gated.
criteria.gates: expansion = the ToWield Expansion(389) BitAnd criterion, authoritative. titleLevelReq = the ToWield TitleLevel(37) criterion: 6 = level 190+, 7 = level 205+.
criteria.caveat: Where two models tie on dpsProxy the one with the lower ipWeightedReq is listed first. 'Best' here means best on these stated measures and nothing more.

xanWalkthrough.levelBand: Content level 201-220. The finished 'X of the Xan' weapons require title level 6 (level 190+) in their own ToWield criteria; the 'Corrupted Lord of X' versions require title level 7 (level 205+).

steps.what: Get the starting piece: a Beast weapon.
steps.detail: Kill The Beast, the final boss of the Pandemonium playfield (Shadowlands). Pandemonium is reached by killing the portal bosses that open the blue portal onward; an instanced version exists via an altar just inside the zone. The Night Heart is the mid-boss. The Beast respawns on a 9-hour timer.
steps.drops: The Beast drops the weapon as 'Lord of [Sin]' (QL 300) or 'Lady of [Sin]' (QL 299) - identical items otherwise. Over 104 documented kills The Beast dropped 2-4 weapons, 4 armour pieces, both hilts, 1-2 profession stars and one Shadowbreed per kill. No per-weapon drop rate is published.
steps.whichOne: Pick the sin that matches the weapon skill you want. Read from the client data (each Lord/Lady template's own primary wield skill in items.ocp): Abandonment = 1h Blunt, Anger = Assault Rifle, Angst = Rifle, Chaos = Bow, Deceit = Piercing, Envy = MG/SMG, Gluttony = 2h Blunt, Greed = Shotgun, Hatred = 1h Edged, Lust = Pistol, Pride = 2h Edged, Sloth = Grenade, Wisdom = Martial Arts. For Shade the usable starting pieces are: Lord/Lady of Deceit (Piercing) -> Deceit of the Xan; Lord/Lady of Wisdom (Martial Arts) -> Wisdom of the Xan. There is NO Lord/Lady of [sin] weapon, and therefore no Xan weapon, for these skills on this profession's list: Melee Energy.

steps.what: Melee Energy only: build a Sword of Dawn or Sword of Dusk instead.
steps.detail: There is no 'Lord of' weapon for Melee Energy. Clan/Redeemed: Notum Seed + Sunrise Hilt = Sword of Dawn. Omni/Unredeemed: Novictum Seed + Sunset Hilt = Sword of Dusk. This step needs 500 Weapon Smithing - the only real skill requirement in the whole line.
steps.drops: Notum Seed / Novictum Seed drop from The Night Heart in Pandemonium (Redeemed and Unredeemed side respectively); not 100%, and both also appear in player shops. Sunrise Hilt (Clan) and Sunset Hilt (Omni) are 100% NODROP drops from The Beast - recorded at 18.27% and 4.81% over 104 kills. Neutrals capped at 25,000 faction cannot get these.
steps.whichOne: Sword of Dawn -> Dawn of the Xan; Sword of Dusk -> Dusk of the Xan.

steps.what: Get a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device.
steps.detail: The Xan Weapon Upgrade Device is QL 300, NODROP/Unique and is consumed by the combine. It drops in the three Legacy of the Xan team instances entered from floor portals in the Central Hub playfield: The Alien Threat / 'Mitaar Hero' (portal at 350 x 410, boss Technomaster Sinuh), LoX: Ground Chief Vortexx (portal at 523 x 307), and The Xan 12-man (portal at 419 x 324, final boss Deranged Xan). Since patch 18.3 none of them need the old prerequisite quests. No drop rate is published. The combine itself needs NO tradeskill skill.
steps.drops: Drops in all three Legacy of the Xan team instances. No drop rate is published on either allowed source.
steps.whichOne: One device per weapon; it is consumed by the combine.

steps.what: Combine: Xan Weapon Upgrade Device + base weapon = [Sin] of the Xan.
steps.detail: Done in the tradeskill window (Shift+T). NO tradeskill skill is required. The base weapon must be QL 299 or 300.
steps.whichOne: Each Lord/Lady of [sin] becomes '[sin] of the Xan'; Sword of Dawn -> Dawn of the Xan and Sword of Dusk -> Dusk of the Xan. Relevant to Shade: Lord/Lady of Deceit -> Deceit of the Xan (Piercing); Lord/Lady of Wisdom -> Wisdom of the Xan (Martial Arts). (For skills this profession does not use: Abandonment, Anger, Angst, Chaos, Envy, Gluttony, Greed, Hatred, Lust, Pride, Sloth; Lord/Lady of Wisdom -> Kuma Tonfa.) Angst additionally accepts High Lord of Angst; Anger/Envy/Angst additionally accept the matching Superior Rebuilt Perennium weapon.

steps.what: Optional final tier: Modified Xan Weapons.
steps.detail: A finished 'X of the Xan' plus one shop-bought component, QL 150 or higher, consumed. No tradeskill skill required.
steps.whichOne: Gluttony of the Xan + Notum Enriched Nano Paste - 16x Layer = Bhan'Zor Hammer (2h Blunt). Abandonment of the Xan + Notum Enriched Nano Paste - 16x Layer = Kur'Ush Mallet (1h Blunt). Lust of the Xan + Nano Pylon = Peh'Wer Pistol, then Peh'Wer Pistol + Runtime Critical Area Analyzer = Troa'Ler Pistol. (Envy -> Rhat'Ata Gun and Angst -> Gan'Kar Rifle are MG/SMG and Rifle.) There is no documented modified version for Chaos, Pride, Hatred, Dawn or Dusk.

parallelLine.what: The 'Corrupted Lord of [Sin]' weapons (ids 302933-302949) are NOT a step in this chain. They are a separate, parallel endgame line that DROPS from the Pyramid of Home 6-man dungeon (level 201-220), added in patch 18.8.6.
parallelLine.why: Patch 18.8.8 renamed a duplicate 'Chaos of the Xan' entry into the Corrupted Lord of Chaos, which is why the two sets share flavour text in the client data. The Corrupted versions require title level 7 (level 205+) where the 'of the Xan' versions require title level 6 (level 190+), and their damage figures differ.
parallelLine.howToGet: Pyramid of Home ('Dark Pyramid Below'): enter through the large door behind Number Nine in the Temple of Home, Broken Shores (the dungeon sits in the crater north of the city of Home). Access needs a Profession Nanodeck worn, or 'Guarding the Source' completed, or the Legacy of the Xan quests completed. Bosses: Cybernetic Daemon, Azdaja the Joyous, Maiden, Phobettor. No drop rates published.

openQuestions: No drop rate is published for the Xan Weapon Upgrade Device, for individual Lord/Lady of X weapons, or for anything in Pyramid of Home.
ao-universe lists Kuma Tonfa - Right/Left Hand from Lord/Lady of Wisdom; the wiki.aodb.us Xan Weapon Upgrade page does not. Unresolved (Martial Arts, so outside this profession's skills either way).

The client data contains 'Mirror of the Xan' (ids 273645-273680, 302628/302629/302745/302808) and 'Shattered Mirror of the Xan' (302810). Searches of wiki.aodb.us and ao-universe return nothing for either name, so their role is UNKNOWN. They are not weapons (no hand slot) and are not recorded here as a chain component.
A claim that Corrupted weapons can be upgraded with a Xan Weapon Upgrade Device exists online but only on a source outside the allowed list; it is not recorded as fact.

Modified Xan Weapons exist only for Gluttony, Abandonment, Envy, Lust (-> Peh'Wer -> Troa'Ler) and Angst. There is no modified version for Chaos, Pride, Hatred, Deceit, Anger, Greed, Sloth, Dawn, Dusk or Kuma Tonfa - that gap is real, not a research miss.

Per wiki.aodb.us, Modified Xan Weapons were froob-friendly from patch 18.1 until 18.6.17 and are not any more - so the expansion gate recorded here reflects the current client, not their whole history.

rankingIsNotFact: dpsProxy is a comparison number computed from the item's own damage and delay stats. It is not in-game DPS: it ignores initiative caps, crit rate, add-damage, damage modifiers, buffs and special attacks.

No community tier list or player consensus is asserted anywhere in this file. Where a 'best' is named it is best on the stated measure only.
rulesThatAreJudgementCalls: The 'top QL >= 200 AND max damage >= 300' endgame floor for the 'expansion' and 'high-rk' tiers is a threshold chosen here, not a fact from the client data. The TL6/TL7 tiers are authoritative (read from the item's TitleLevel criterion).

correctionsToCommonAssumptions: PERENNIUM IS NOT A SHADE LINE. Perennium weapons are Blaster / Sniper / Beamer - ranged, for Soldiers, Agents and Fixers. There is no Perennium Piercing weapon.
VEKTOR ND IS A SHOTGUN, not a Piercing weapon.

"BLADES OF INRIKUS" DOES NOT EXIST. The real item is BLADES OF BOLTAR, crafted from an Energy Redistribution Unit plus a QL250+ Kyr'Ozch Energy Rapier Type 992, and upgradeable further into X1-R4 Viral Force-Blades with an Action Probability Estimator. That chain DOES start from a Shade-relevant Piercing weapon.
